members.name: Dennis G. Rodriguez
members.role: Co-Founder & Board Member | Former Guam Senator and Health Committee Chairman
members.preview: Dennis G. Rodriguez, Jr. is a co-founder of Todu Guam Foundation and a former Guam Senator whose public service included leadership of the legislative committee responsible for health and human services. His experience in healthcare policy, advocacy, and community leadership continues to help shape the Foundation’s vision for improving access to care throughout Guam.
members.bio: Dennis G. Rodriguez, Jr. is a co-founder of Todu Guam Foundation and a former Senator in the Guam Legislature, where his public service included leadership of the legislative committee responsible for health and human services.  His experience in public policy and healthcare advocacy helped shape a strong understanding of the challenges affecting healthcare access in Guam and the importance of developing community-based solutions to address those needs.  As a co-founder of Todu Guam Foundation, Mr. Rodriguez has helped advance the organization’s vision of improving access to quality healthcare and bringing together providers, community organizations, and partners to better serve Guam’s people.  He continues to provide the Board with experience in healthcare policy, community engagement, organizational leadership, and a longstanding commitment to improving the health and well-being of the people of Guam.

members.name: Dr. Yolanda Carrera
members.preview: A respected retired pediatrician, Dr. Yolanda Carrera brings decades of experience caring for Guam’s children and families to the Todu Guam Foundation Board. Her clinical perspective and commitment to compassionate care help guide the Foundation’s mission to improve healthcare access and community health.
members.bio: Dr. Yolanda Carrera is a retired pediatrician who dedicated decades of her medical career to caring for children and families in Guam. Her extensive experience in pediatric medicine provides the Todu Guam Foundation Board of Directors with an important clinical perspective and a deep understanding of the healthcare needs of children and families in the community.  Throughout her career, Dr. Carrera has been committed to compassionate, patient-centered care and the health and well-being of Guam’s families.  As a member of the Board, she helps guide Todu Guam Foundation’s commitment to accessible, high-quality healthcare, prevention, early intervention, and healthier communities throughout Guam.

members.name: Lena Calvo-Rodriguez
members.preview: Lena specializes in community outreach and growing grassroots volunteer networks.
members.bio: Lena specializes in community outreach and has been instrumental in growing our grassroots volunteer networks.

members.name: Maria Elizabeth V. Cristi, PE
members.role: Board Member | Principal Engineer & Radiation Safety Officer, Pacific Soils Engineering & Testing
members.preview: Maria Elizabeth V. Cristi, PE, brings expertise in engineering, safety, regulatory compliance, and organizational leadership to the Todu Guam Foundation Board. Her professional perspective supports strong governance, thoughtful planning, and responsible stewardship as the Foundation continues to grow.
members.bio: Maria Elizabeth V. Cristi, PE, is a professional engineer and serves as Principal Engineer and Radiation Safety Officer at Pacific Soils Engineering & Testing.  Her professional background brings valuable expertise in engineering, safety, regulatory compliance, planning, and organizational leadership to the Todu Guam Foundation Board of Directors. Her perspective supports thoughtful decision-making, accountability, and responsible stewardship as the Foundation expands its programs, partnerships, and community impact.  Through her Board service, Ms. Cristi supports Todu Guam Foundation’s mission to expand access to healthcare and build healthier, stronger communities throughout Guam.

members.name: Rev. Msgr. James L.G. Benavente
members.role: Board Member | Roman Catholic Archdiocese of Agaña
members.preview: Rev. Msgr. James L.G. Benavente brings decades of pastoral leadership and community service to the Todu Guam Foundation Board. His perspective, grounded in compassion, dignity, and service to others, reinforces the Foundation’s commitment to caring for the whole person.
members.bio: Rev. Msgr. James L.G. Benavente is a longtime Catholic priest and community leader of the Archdiocese of Agaña. Through decades of ministry, he has served the people of Guam through pastoral leadership, spiritual guidance, and community service.  His experience provides the Todu Guam Foundation Board of Directors with a perspective rooted in compassion, service, dignity, and a deep understanding of the needs of Guam’s families and communities.  As a member of the Board, Msgr. Benavente supports the Foundation’s commitment to caring for the whole person and ensuring that compassionate healthcare and community support remain accessible to those who need them most.

members.name: Anthony P. Sgro
members.role: Board Member | President, Fitness Solutions / Paradise Fitness Center
members.preview: Anthony P. Sgro brings extensive business leadership and a longstanding commitment to health and wellness to the Todu Guam Foundation Board. His experience strengthens the Foundation’s focus on prevention, healthy lifestyles, and building a healthier Guam.
members.bio: Anthony P. Sgro is President of Fitness Solutions and Paradise Fitness Center and a longtime advocate for health, fitness, and wellness in Guam.  Mr. Sgro brings extensive business leadership, entrepreneurship, and health and wellness experience to the Todu Guam Foundation Board of Directors. His perspective strengthens the Foundation’s emphasis on prevention and the important connection between healthy lifestyles and long-term health outcomes.  Through his Board service, Mr. Sgro supports Todu Guam Foundation’s vision of creating a healthier Guam through greater access to healthcare, prevention, education, and community wellness.
